The /live/export/logs API provides a response in the following format:

200 Success

text/plain - Logs of the live deployments of the project.
content string
One log line per row.
Example 
Launching analysis for L-6e9d8a78f5af89d401f630585be90e43 with LEAN Engine v2.5.0.0.17503
2026-10-08 14:20:04 Algorithm started

401 Authentication Error

UnauthorizedError Model - Unauthorized response from the API. Key is missing, invalid, or timestamp is too old for hash.
www_authenticate string
Header
